{{short description|Singaporean-American statistician}}
'''Wei-Yin Loh''' is a Singaporean statistician.

Loh obtained his Bachelor of Science in mathematics with first-class honours at the [[National University of Singapore|University of Singapore]] in 1974. He remained at the University of Singapore until 1977 to complete a Master of Science in the same subject, then enrolled at the [[University of California, Berkeley]] for a PhD in statistics.<ref name="uwmstats">{{cite news |title=Professor Wei-Yin Loh |url=https://pages.stat.wisc.edu/~loh/ |access-date=19 September 2025 |publisher=University of Wisconsin–Madison Department of Statistics}}</ref> Loh completed his doctoral dissertation, "Tail-orderings on Symmetric Distributions with Statistical Applications", under the supervision of [[Erich Leo Lehmann]] in 1982.<ref>{{cite news |title=Wei-yin Loh Professor |url=https://statistics.berkeley.edu/people/wei-yin-loh |access-date=19 September 2025 |publisher=University of California, Berkeley Department of Statistics}}</ref><ref>{{MathGenealogy}}</ref>

Loh is a professor of statistics at the [[University of Wisconsin–Madison]].<ref name="statuwm">{{cite news |title=Wei-Yin Loh Professor, Statistics |url=https://stat.wisc.edu/staff/loh-wei-yin/ |access-date=19 September 2025 |publisher=University of Wisconsin–Madison}}</ref> He was elected a fellow of the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]] in 1991,<ref name="uwmstats"/><ref name="imsfellows">{{cite news |title=Honored IMS Fellows |url=https://imstat.org/honored-ims-fellows/ |access-date=19 September 2025 |publisher=Institute of Mathematical Statistics}}</ref> and to an equivalent honour by the [[American Statistical Association]] in 1998.<ref name="uwmstats"/><ref name="asafellows">{{cite news |title=ASA Fellows |url=https://ww2.amstat.org/fellows/ |access-date=19 September 2025 |publisher=American Statistical Association}}</ref>

Loh is the father of [[Po-Shen Loh]], a mathematician at [[Carnegie Mellon University]] and coach of the US [[International Mathematical Olympiad]] team, [[Po-Ling Loh]], a statistician at the [[University of Cambridge]], and Po-Ru Loh, an associate professor of medicine at [[Harvard University]]. His brother, Wei-Liem Loh, is a statistician at the [[National University of Singapore]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://ctri.wisc.edu/2020/01/10/breathe-2-collaborator-wrote-the-code-that-advanced-uw-ctri-research/|title=BREATHE 2 Collaborator Wrote the Code that Advanced UW-CTRI Research|first=Tim|last=Baker|date=10 January 2020|work=UW Center for Tobacco Research and Intervention|publisher=University of Wisconsin|access-date=2025-09-30}}</ref>
